strings.Até duas tarefas por vez. Você escolhe q: Up to two tasks at a time. Choose when to save the files to your device.
strings.Quando a tarefa estiver concluída, o áud: Once the task is complete, the audio is saved in the selected folder. Choose Listen or Open folder.

strings.Continuar em segundo plano ao fechar ou: Keep running in the background when closing or minimizing
strings.O Acervo fica na bandeja do Windows e co: Acervo stays in the Windows system tray and keeps downloading. Double-click the tray icon or open Acervo.exe again to return quickly.
strings.Sem tarefas, os responsáveis pelos downl: When idle, download workers wait for tasks. The hidden interface pauses its requests and asks Windows to reduce memory usage. Resource usage is not zero.
strings.Sair encerra completamente e pausa a fil: Exit closes the app and pauses pending tasks until the next launch. Downloads require the PC to stay on, awake and connected to the internet.

strings.MP4: melhor vídeo compatível disponível: MP4: best available compatible video up to 1080p. Other codecs may be converted. Audio-only sources become an MP4 with artwork or a plain background.

strings.Todas as selecionadas entram na fila com: Queue all selected items with one click. Two transfers run at a time and the queue continues automatically. Uncertain matches wait for review while other tasks continue. Files already saved in this format are skipped.

strings.Escolha uma pasta, cole um link ou pesqu: Choose a folder, paste a link or search for media, then select MP3 or MP4. Acervo analyzes the source and saves the file on your computer. No hosting service or commands are needed.
strings.arquivos HTTPS de áudio públicos, itens: public HTTPS audio files, public Internet Archive items, and public YouTube videos and playlists through yt-dlp (up to 500 videos per analysis). Only download content you own or are authorized to download. Blocked links and DRM are not bypassed.
strings.você faz o login numa janela normal do E: sign in yourself in a regular Edge or Chrome window using Acervo's temporary profile. The app reads the titles, artists, albums and durations displayed on Liked Songs. It does not use the developer API, request a Client ID or extract cookies or tokens. Site changes or restrictions may prevent reading.
strings.o formato original preserva o áudio obti: original format preserves the downloaded audio. MP4 uses source video when available, or creates a video with artwork and audio. Direct MP3 conversion uses VBR quality 0. Converting to MP3 does not improve the original recording.
strings.biblioteca, histórico e logs ficam na pa: your library, history and logs stay in the Dados folder next to the app. Spotify uses a temporary profile separate from your personal browser. Disconnecting closes the window and requests profile cleanup. Internal app communication stays on this PC and starts and stops automatically.
strings.os áudios salvos continuam na pasta esco: saved audio stays in your selected folder and can be played without internet. Playback requires a supported format.
